description: Operator oracle for the local demo target (assets/_shot_target.py) used ONLY to capture real CLI screenshots. External ground truth, not a Sentinel finding: each rule declares what SHOULD be true; the engine freshly re-probes the live demo target and reports a finding only when observed behaviour contradicts this. Deliberately mixes real violations with compliant controls so the captured board shows the honest differential.

rules.note: Must not be readable anonymously. The demo target leaks the whole collection (200) — a real broken-access-control flaw the judge reproduces and CONFIRMS.
COMPLIANT CONTROL: the demo target denies this (401), so the judge returns DISPROVED and NO finding — proof Sentinel never manufactures a verdict.

expectations.rationale: Primary XSS defence. Absent on the demo target — CONFIRMED, then the shield injects one.
A wildcard CORS origin lets any site read cross-origin responses. The demo target returns '*' — CONFIRMED, then stripped.
Without it the full URL can leak to third parties. Absent — CONFIRMED, then injected.
A non-standard information-disclosure header. Present — CONFIRMED, then stripped.
COMPLIANT CONTROL: the demo target already sends 'nosniff' — DISPROVED, no finding.
A session cookie without HttpOnly is readable by script — the classic session-theft / XSS-chaining pivot. The demo target ships it without HttpOnly — CONFIRMED, then the shield adds the flag.
Without Secure the cookie is sent over plaintext HTTP. Absent — CONFIRMED, then the shield adds it.
COMPLIANT CONTROL: the cookie carries no SameSite=None, so 'must not equal None' holds — DISPROVED, no finding.
